# jev-gan

> **The substrate GAN.** JEV decides, JEPA predicts, multiple LLMs play producer/critic in a fully-observable game.

This is the umbrella repo for the GAN-game-on-substrate pattern.

## The 5 components

1. **Producer** (LLM): generates outputs from a paradigm
2. **Critic** (LLM or JEV): scores outputs
3. **JEV** (schema-constrained oracle): makes decisions about quality, severity, edge cases
4. **JEPA** (joint embedding predictor): predicts which outputs will be best
5. **Substrate** (cells with prev_hash): every output is a cell, every game is a chain

## The games

This repo hosts implementations of:

- **[jev-diffusion](https://github.com/SuperInstance/jev-diffusion)**: image description
- **[peanut-gallery](https://github.com/SuperInstance/peanut-gallery)**: multi-model critique
- **[madlibs-gan](https://github.com/SuperInstance/madlibs-gan)**: paradigm-based generation
- **[paradigm-edges](https://github.com/SuperInstance/paradigm-edges)**: edge case discovery

All compose. All use the same substrate cell with prev_hash chain.

## The pattern

```
Producer A produces → Substrate cell 1
Critic B critiques  → Substrate cell 2
JEV votes           → Substrate cell 3
JEPA predicts       → Substrate cell 4
Producer A revises  → Substrate cell 5 (next round)

(prev_hash links every cell, witness-log records every step)
```

## Files

- `gan.py` — the unified GAN loop
- `paradigms.py` — paradigm definitions
- `voting.py` — JEV + JEPA voting
- `examples/` — pre-run competitions
